headline: Maui County Commission on Healing Solutions for Homelessness

meeting.body: Maui County Commission on Healing Solutions for Homelessness
meeting.summary: The commission heard recommendations on involving faith-based groups, elected its chair and vice chair, and learned a homeless strategic plan draft is due December 20.
meeting.recap: The commission welcomed a new member who fills its faith-based seat.[[0:08:03]] A working group presented recommendations on involving faith-based groups in fighting homelessness.[[0:10:53]] Another asks for grant funding to collect district-by-district data on unsheltered people.[[0:17:42]] Another asks the mayor to direct all County departments to include the commission in homelessness programs and policies.[[0:21:26]] The commission plans to vote on each recommendation at a later meeting.[[0:26:18]] Members elected the acting chair as chair for the new term.[[0:47:07]] Members voted unanimously to keep the vice chair in that role.[[0:59:27]] The department director said the department is now called the Department of Human Concerns.[[1:22:01]] A final draft of a homeless strategic plan is due to the County on December 20.[[1:22:56]] A testifier doing outreach reported a large increase in unhoused people using their services.[[1:26:29]] A testifier said people could not get back belongings taken in homeless sweeps.[[1:30:51]] The chair urged commissioners to watch a December 3 meeting and review the bill.[[1:37:10]]
decided: Members approved moving the working group's presentation earlier in the agenda by voice vote.
Members elected the acting chair as chair for the new term by voice vote.
Members voted unanimously to keep the vice chair in that role.
meeting.next: The commission will decide whether to approve each recommendation at its next meeting. The director asked the chair to put the homeless strategic plan on the January agenda. The department will issue a request for proposals for federal emergency solutions grant funding, posted on the Department of Finance website. The chair said staff will check which commission seats are open and get back to a testifier.

moments.q: Department update on homeless strategic plan
Chair asks commission to think about its value ahead of a cost-of-government review
